title: Workgroup settings
not-found: This workgroup does not exist or you cannot read it.
unverified: The membership history of this organization is not verified yet.
defaults: No settings were saved yet; the defaults are shown.
invalid: The stored settings could not be read; the defaults are shown.
read-only: You have read access to these settings.
repositories.label: Limit repositories (optional, one owner/name per line)
repositories.hint: Without entries, every repository of the GitHub connection is allowed. Only add entries if you want to limit the workgroup to specific repositories.
repositories.none: Every repository of the GitHub connection is allowed.
protected.label: Protected branches (one name or pattern with * per line)
protected.hint: Optional. Agents never create, commit to or push to these branches. Without entries, the branch protection of the repository at GitHub applies.
protected.none: No branch is protected here; the branch protection of the repository at GitHub applies.
draft.label: Open pull requests as drafts by default
draft.yes: Pull requests are drafts by default.
draft.no: Pull requests are ready for review by default.
error.pattern_invalid: Line {line}: “{value}” is not a branch name or pattern.
conflict: Someone saved newer settings while you were editing.
